- If sentiment is positive (≥0.2) in the recent history, model tends to overestimate; reduce forecast peak values by 1–3%.
- If sentiment is negative (≤-0.3) in recent history, model tends to underestimate; increase forecast lows by 1–3%.
- After a recent spike in price (last 3–5 days), model often overshoots; apply a 2–5 day decay filter to smooth out overreaction.
- Model consistently overpredicts early in the 30-day horizon; apply a 1–2 day lag correction for the first 5–7 days.
- Mean reversion is strong in 30-day forecasts; if forecast is >10% above recent 10-day average, reduce by 5–10%.
- If sentiment history shows a sharp reversal (e.g., +0.2 → -0.3), model often fails to adjust; apply a 3–5 day smoothing window to sentiment-weighted average.
